items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember Ed Burke or Bradley Bullock? They were trombone players with Walter Bond? ... [INTERVIEWEE] I met him.

ctx.x: Joe, uh, Joe White. I said, I'm sorry. That's right, Joe White. And, uh, he was short of, uh, two, three boys. Well, he was just, he was just loafing with us. So we let, uh, him have him. And he joined him and, uh, the boys began, he began to, I guess search the billboard and he found out why there was a bunch of loose musicians that was, uh, and he began to gather them in, you know, one, one or two at a time, write them and place them in, set them in. And that's why he, he broke up the band in his, in Jackson.…
What did Walter Bond play mostly?
